headline: Vet-formulated nutrition for your senior dog
body: Your older dog deserves complete ingredient transparency. Our vet-recommended recipe is crafted exclusively for senior joint health and longevity, delivered right to your door every month.
rationale: This copy directly incorporates the persona's preference for vet-recommended formulas and ingredient transparency while speaking to their view of the pet as a family member who needs senior care. It avoids generic pet framing and ultra-cheap positioning.
